Our Planning Services

Transparent pricing and comprehensive service offerings tailored to your celebration style.

Destination Wedding

Comprehensive Wedding Planning

Complete end-to-end wedding planning and on-site management for couples who want every detail expertly handled.

What's Included:

  • Full-service, on-site, multi-day event management
  • Vendor procurement, contractual oversight, & timeline synchronization
  • Budget Development with strategic monitoring & financial transparency
  • Destination discovery & assessment with logistical coordination
  • Room block & group rates negotiation & arrangement
  • Personalized website for Guest RSVPs & information
  • Guest arrival management
Investment Starting at $15,000 + 10% of total wedding investment

We design multi-day destination celebrations for couples investing $120,000–$250,000 in their wedding weekend, exclusive of accommodations. Your investment reflects guest count, destination complexity, and the level of customization and experience design you envision for your guests.

Curated Journeys

Travel & Honeymoon Planning

One planning service for the journeys that matter: honeymoons, anniversaries, milestone trips, and family gatherings. Designed, booked, and handled by one person.

What's Included:

  • Destination & property selection based on your preferences
  • Virtuoso & preferred partner booking with on-property benefits
  • Personalized itinerary design & activity coordination
  • Flights, transfers, & travel logistics
  • Honeymoon design & romantic touches for newly married couples
  • One point of contact before & during your trip
Planning Investment Starting at $1,500 Complimentary for wedding clients

The planning fee covers itinerary design, booking through Virtuoso and preferred partner relationships, and one person to call before and during your trip.
